howPage.title: How it works
howPage.intro: Platform setup, guest onboarding, and daily ops — end to end.

steps.title: Set up the café
steps.body: Name, color, logo, and “X stamps → reward”. SuperAdmin marks the subscription ACTIVE.

steps.title: Register the guest
steps.body: Cashier enters a phone number. The system creates the customer, first stamp, and Wallet invite.

steps.title: Add to Wallet
steps.body: Via SMS (or mock log) the guest saves the pass to Apple or Google Wallet. No app install.

steps.title: Stamp & redeem
steps.body: Each visit adds a stamp; at the threshold the reward is redeemed and the counter resets. Pass syncs.

howPage.opsBody: Cashiers get a single numpad screen. Owners see customers, reports, and café details. SuperAdmins manage tenants.

howPage.timelineIntro: What happens from first visit to loyal regular — in order.

timeline.title: Arrives at the counter

deepDive.title: Why Wallet beats another loyalty app
deepDive.body: Guests already open Apple or Google Wallet dozens of times a week. StampWell puts your brand there — with live stamp counts, reward status, and push updates when balances change.
bullets: Brand color, logo, and barcode on every pass
Instant sync after each counter action
No App Store friction for your regulars
Works on iPhone and Android from day one

checklist.title: Included in every active tenant
checklist.description: Core platform capabilities regardless of which plan you start on.

faq.q: Can I run multiple card types at once?
faq.a: Yes — on Growth and above. Starter focuses on one stamp card; higher tiers unlock point, cashback, and event passes side by side.

faq.q: Does the guest need to install anything?
faq.a: No. They add a pass to Apple or Google Wallet from an SMS link — same flow as a boarding pass or event ticket.

faq.q: What happens when a reward is redeemed?
faq.a: The counter resets on the pass, the redemption is logged, and owner reports update within seconds.

kvkkBody: Data controller: StampWell, a legal entity (tax ID: 11111111111, Yeşilce Mahallesi Define Sokak No:6, Turkey). Contact person for data protection (KVKK): Batuhan Küçük, bennbatuu@gmail.com, +90 541 472 58 20.

Data we process: first and last name, phone number, email address, date of birth (if provided), business name and sector, loyalty records (stamps, points, rewards, spend amounts and transaction dates), Wallet pass identifier, IP address and system logs.

Purposes: operating the loyalty programme, creating and updating Apple and Google Wallet passes, sending invitations and notices by SMS, answering support requests, preventing security incidents and abuse, and meeting legal obligations.
Legal bases: performance of a contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest, and your explicit consent. Promotional SMS and email are sent only with your explicit consent.

Transfers: data is stored in Turkey and not transferred abroad. To deliver the service, SMS providers (e.g. Netgsm, İletimerkezi), Apple and Google Wallet infrastructure and cloud hosting providers act as data processors and only process what the service requires.
Retention: your data is kept until you ask for it to be deleted. Records that the law requires us to keep are retained for the period set by that law.

Your rights: under Article 11 of the KVKK law you may ask whether your data is processed, request information, correction or deletion, and object to processing. Send requests to the email address above.

Explicit consent: by reading this text I agree to receive promotional and informational SMS and email. I can withdraw this consent at any time by email; withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out.
privacyBody: Scope: this privacy policy applies to people who visit the website and submit contact, demo or sign-up forms. Customer data of the loyalty programme is described separately in the KVKK notice.
Data collected: information you enter in forms (name, business name, email, phone, sector, message) and technical logs kept for security and performance (IP address, browser type, visit time).

Cookies: the website uses analytics cookies only. They measure visit counts and page performance. We do not use advertising cookies and do not share data with advertising networks. You can delete or block cookies in your browser; some page features may then be limited.
Cookie consent: we ask for your explicit consent before setting analytics cookies. You can change your choice at any time in your browser settings.
Security: data is encrypted in transit. Access rights are role-based and only authorised staff can access personal data.
Sharing: we do not sell or rent personal data. We share it with third parties only where the law requires it.
Your rights and contact: to exercise your rights under the KVKK law, write to bennbatuu@gmail.com. Requests are answered within thirty days at the latest.
termsBody: Parties and scope: these terms govern the relationship between StampWell and the businesses that use the platform (website, Wallet passes, SMS invitations and admin panel).
Free trial: every plan includes a 14-day free trial. If you continue after the trial, the fee for the chosen plan is charged.
Pricing: plans are billed monthly or yearly. Current prices and applicable tax are always shown on the website. The stated yearly discount applies to yearly payments.

Subscription and cancellation: you may cancel your subscription at any time. Cancellation takes effect from the next billing period and no refund is given for the period already paid. We will notify you when temporary features (e.g. the mock SMS mode) are retired.

Plan changes: starter and growth plans may receive an additional 3-day trial. Pro and business plans include monthly usage limits defined in the plan description; extra charges may apply when limits are exceeded.
Your obligations: provide accurate information, keep your account credentials safe and use the platform lawfully. Illegal content and unsolicited marketing are not allowed.
Service level: we operate the platform with reasonable care, but we do not promise uninterrupted or error-free service or any specific availability level.

Liability and disputes: our liability is limited to the fees paid for the relevant service. Disputes are subject to Turkish law and the courts specified by us. Mandatory rights of consumers are not affected.
Language: these terms are available in Turkish, English and Russian. The Turkish text prevails in case of dispute.
